```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(scRepertoire)
library(VDJdive)
library(ggpubr)
library(ECLIPSE)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringdist)
library(Biostrings)

source("/home/ecb86/Desktop/R_tools/VDJdive_ECLIPSE_paperFunctions.R")
set.seed(16)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                         Pre-Processing                               ###
############################################################################

braun <- readRDS("/nfs/roberts/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/braun_cancer_cell_2021/processed/braun_cancer_cell_seurat.rds")

braun@meta.data <- braun@meta.data %>% separate(Sample, into = c("donor", "tissue"), remove = FALSE, sep = "_")
braun@meta.data <- braun@meta.data %>% mutate(tissue = case_when(
                                                                 tissue %in% c("T", "T2") ~ "Tumor",
                                                                 tissue == "N" ~ "Normal",
                                                                 tissue %in% c("M", "V")  ~ "Other"))

cd8 <- subset(braun, subset = ClusterName_TCells %in% c("Treg", "Activated CD4.1", "Activated CD4.2", "CD4 TCM.1", "CD4 TCM.2", "Mito-high T cells", "-1"), invert = TRUE)

dirs <- list.files("/nfs/roberts/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output_indexHoppingRemoved", recursive = TRUE, pattern = "all_contig_annotations\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
dirs <- dirs[!str_detect(dirs, "SC_VDJ_ASSEMBLER_CS")]
dirs <- str_replace(dirs, "all.*$", "")

matching <- read.csv("/nfs/roberts/pi/pi_db2475/ecb86/sc_datasets/braun_cancer_cell/braun_matching2.csv")
matching <- matching %>% filter(Sample != "")

cd8@meta.data <- cd8@meta.data %>% left_join(matching[, 2:3], by = "Sample")
cd8@meta.data <- as.data.frame(cd8@meta.data)
rownames(cd8@meta.data) <- cd8$Cell_barcode
cd8$Cell_Barcode <- str_replace(cd8$Cell_barcode, "\\-.*$", "-1")

ElbowPlot(cd8, ndims = 50)
cd8 <- RunUMAP(cd8, dims = 1:30)

cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "PMCH+ terminally Exhausted CD8.1"] <- "PMCH+ terminally \n Exhausted CD8.1"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.2"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.2"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.3"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.3"

cd8s <- ECLIPSE(contig_folder_paths = dirs, 
                contig_type = "all", 
                seurat_object = cd8, 
                batch = "index", 
                donor = "donor", 
                group = "donor", 
                original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode")

cd8s <- tcrDoubletDetect(cd8s)

```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                             Figure 4A                                ###
############################################################################

d1 <- read.csv("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/analysis/simulations/remove/d1.csv")
d1$type <- "remove"

a1 <- read.csv("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/analysis/simulations/add/d1.csv")
a1$type <- "add"

sim <- rbind(d1, a1)

sim <- sim %>% ungroup() %>% complete(steady, altered, type, iteration)

sim$pct[is.na(sim$pct)] <- 0

### Need to group by iteration and take the mean smh
sim2 <- sim %>% group_by(steady, altered, type) %>%
                summarise(mn_pct = mean(pct),
                          md_pct = median(pct),
                          Count = n(),
                          mn_count = mean(count),
                          md_count = median(count))


sim2 %>% ggplot() + 
         geom_col(aes(x = altered, y = md_pct, fill = steady, color = steady), lwd = 0.4, width = 0.85) + 
         theme_bw() +
         labs(y = "Median % of cells", x = "TCR chain set\nmanipulation") +
         theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"), 
               legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black", lineheight = 0.7), 
               axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
               legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 6), 
               axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"), 
               axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 1), vjust = 2),
               legend.key.size = unit(0.1, "cm"),
               legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
               legend.box.margin = margin(l = -2, r = -2),
               legend.margin = margin(l = 0, r = 0),
               legend.spacing.y = unit(2, "pt"),
               axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
               axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
               axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1)),
               strip.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
               panel.grid = element_blank()) +
         scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.02), 
                            breaks = seq(0, 100, 20), 
                            guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) + 
         labs(fill = "Impact on\npredicted\nclonotype", color = "Impact on\npredicted\nclonotype") + 
         scale_x_discrete(labels = c("-", "+"), 
                          expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
         scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(c("chartreuse4", "gold", "dodgerblue4"), 0.7), 
                           limits = c("Call Now\nAmbiguous", "New Call", "Same Call"),
                           labels = c("No\nprediction", "Incorrect\nprediction", "Same\nprediction")) +
         scale_color_manual(values = c("chartreuse4", "gold", "dodgerblue4"), 
                           limits = c("Call Now\nAmbiguous", "New Call", "Same Call"),
                           labels = c("No\nprediction", "Incorrect\nprediction", "Same\nprediction")) +
         facet_wrap(~type, labeller = as_labeller(c("add" = "Chain\naddition", "remove" = "Chain\nremoval")))

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/4a.pdf", width = 2.0, height = 2.5, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                         Extended Data 3B                             ###
############################################################################
meta_rcc <- read.csv("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/analysis/sensitivity_analysis/meta_rcc.csv")
accuracy_rcc <- read.csv("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/analysis/sensitivity_analysis/accuracy_rcc.csv")
coverage_rcc <- read.csv("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/analysis/sensitivity_analysis/coverage_rcc.csv")

cov_rcc <- coverage_rcc %>% group_by(condition, donor) %>%
                        mutate(pct_with_tcr = 100 * pct / sum(pct[which(cloneCallSource %in% c("VDJdive", "scRepertoire"))])) %>%
                        ungroup()

cov_rcc <- cov_rcc %>% group_by(condition, cloneCallSource) %>%
                       summarise(md_pct = median(pct),
                                 mn_pct = mean(pct),
                                 md_pct_with_tcr = median(pct_with_tcr),
                                 mn_pct_with_tcr = mean(pct_with_tcr))

cov_rcc <- cov_rcc %>% filter(cloneCallSource == "VDJdive") %>%
                       mutate(iteration = -0.3)

acc_rcc <- accuracy_rcc %>% filter(altered == TRUE) %>% 
                            complete(iteration, condition, steady) %>%
                            filter(steady == "New Call")

acc_rcc$pct[is.na(acc_rcc$pct)] <- 0 


acc2_rcc <- acc_rcc %>% group_by(condition) %>%
                        summarise(count = n(),
                                  md_pct_newcall = median(pct),
                                  mn_pct_newcall = mean(pct))


sens_rcc <- cov_rcc %>% left_join(acc2_rcc, by = "condition")



### Final
sens_rcc %>% ggplot(aes(x = md_pct_with_tcr, y = md_pct_newcall)) +
             geom_path(aes(group = iteration), color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5) +
             geom_point(color = "coral2", size = 1) + 
             geom_text_repel(aes(label = condition), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf, force = 0.01, segment.size = 0.2) +
             theme_bw() + xlim(50, 100) + ylim(0, 20) +
             theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
                   panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.7),
                   axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
                   axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
                   plot.title = element_text(color = "black", hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
                   axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
                   axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
                   axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1)),
                   axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 1))) +
             labs(x = "Median % of cells with a\nclonotype predicted", y = "Median % of incorrect predictions", title = "Renal cell carcinoma")

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/s3b.pdf", width = 2.2, height = 2.5, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
```
```{r}
###                             Figure 4B                                ###
############################################################################
r2 <- read.csv("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/analysis/simulations/remove/d2.csv")
a2 <- read.csv("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/analysis/simulations/add/d2.csv")

r2$type <- "remove"
a2$type <- "add"

sim_div <- rbind(r2, a2)

sim_div <- sim_div %>% pivot_longer(c(1:3), names_to = "condition", values_to = "shannon")

sim_div2 <- sim_div %>% group_by(iteration, type) %>%
                        mutate(rel_shannon = 100 * shannon / shannon[condition == "gt"]) %>%
                        ungroup()

sim_div2 %>% ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = rel_shannon)) + 
             geom_path(aes(group = iteration), color = "black", alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.2, position = position_jitter(width = 0.35, height = 0, seed = 7)) +
             geom_point(aes(fill = condition), color = "black", shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.3, position = position_jitter(width = 0.35, height = 0, seed = 7)) +
             theme_bw() +
             scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkseagreen4", "darkmagenta", "bisque")) +
             theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
                   axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
                   panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
                   panel.grid = element_blank(),
                   legend.position = "none",
                   axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
                   axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
                   axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.05),
                   axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 3),
                   strip.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
             scale_x_discrete(limits = c("gt", "sim", "sim_e"), 
                             labels = c("Ground truth", "Simulation", "Simulation then ECLIPSE")) +
             scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.2)),
                                guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
             labs(x = "", y = "Adjusted Shannon index\n(% of ground truth)") +
             facet_wrap(~type, labeller = as_labeller(c("add" = "Chain\naddition", "remove" = "Chain\nremoval"))) +
             stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal", size = 1.5, label.sep = "\n", label.y = 118, label.x.npc = 0.15)

sim_div3 <- sim_div2 %>% mutate(condition2 = case_when(
                                                      type == "remove" & condition == "sim" ~ "Sim. (- chain)",
                                                      type == "add" & condition == "sim" ~ "Sim. (+ chain)",
                                                      condition == "sim_e" ~ paste("Sim.", "\U2192", "ECLIPSE"),
                                                      condition == "gt" ~ "Ground truth"))

kw <- sim_div3 %>% group_by(type) %>%
                   summarise(p = kruskal.test(rel_shannon ~ condition2)$p.value) %>%
                   mutate(label = paste0("Kruskal-Wallis,\n  p = ", round(p, digits = 6)),
                          x = 2,
                          y = 119)
                            

sim_div3 %>% ggplot(aes(x = condition2, y = rel_shannon)) + 
             geom_path(aes(group = iteration), color = "black", alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.2, position = position_jitter(width = 0.35, height = 0, seed = 7)) +
             geom_point(aes(fill = condition2), color = "black", shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.3, position = position_jitter(width = 0.35, height = 0, seed = 7)) +
             geom_text(data = kw, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 1.5) +
             theme_bw() +
             scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkseagreen4", "darkmagenta", "darkmagenta", "bisque")) +
             theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
                   axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
                   panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
                   panel.grid = element_blank(),
                   legend.position = "none",
                   axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
                   axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
                   axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.05),
                   axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 3),
                   strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
```

```{r}
meta <- meta %>% separate(ctaa_a, into = c("ctaa_a1", "ctaa_a2"), sep = ":::", remove = TRUE) %>%
                 separate(ctaa_b, into = c("ctaa_b1", "ctaa_b2"), sep = ":::", remove = TRUE)

meta$ctaa_a1[meta$ctaa_a1 == "NA"] <- NA
meta$ctaa_a2[meta$ctaa_a2 == "NA"] <- NA
meta$ctaa_b1[meta$ctaa_b1 == "NA"] <- NA
meta$ctaa_b2[meta$ctaa_b2 == "NA"] <- NA


meta <- meta %>% filter(cloneCallSource == "VDJdive") %>%
                 mutate(a1_pred = str_detect(scR_CTaa, paste0("^", ctaa_a1, "_|^", ctaa_a1, ";|;", ctaa_a1, "_")),
                        a2_pred = str_detect(scR_CTaa, paste0("^", ctaa_a2, "_|^", ctaa_a2, ";|;", ctaa_a2, "_")),
                        b1_pred = str_detect(scR_CTaa, paste0("_", ctaa_b1, "$|_", ctaa_b1, ";|;", ctaa_b1, "$")),
                        b2_pred = str_detect(scR_CTaa, paste0("_", ctaa_b2, "$|_", ctaa_b2, ";|;", ctaa_b2, "$")))

meta$a1_pred[is.na(meta$ctaa_a1)] <- FALSE
meta$a2_pred[is.na(meta$ctaa_a2)] <- FALSE
meta$b1_pred[is.na(meta$ctaa_b1)] <- FALSE
meta$b2_pred[is.na(meta$ctaa_b2)] <- FALSE

meta <- meta %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(chain_count = sum(!is.na(ctaa_a1), !is.na(ctaa_a2), !is.na(ctaa_b1), !is.na(ctaa_b2)))

meta <- meta %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(existing_chains = sum(a1_pred, a2_pred, b1_pred, b2_pred),
                                      predicted_chains = chain_count - sum(a1_pred, a2_pred, b1_pred, b2_pred))


match <- match %>% unite("key", c(scR_CTaa, CTaa, donor), sep = " ", remove = FALSE)
meta <- meta %>% unite("key", c(scR_CTaa, CTaa, donor), sep = " ", remove = FALSE)

meta_pred <- meta %>% filter(predicted_chains > 0)

meta_pred_large <- meta %>% filter(predicted_chains > 0) %>%
                            group_by(scR_CTaa) %>%
                            filter(n() >= 10) %>%
                            ungroup() %>%
                            group_by(donor, scR_CTaa, CTaa, key) %>%
                            summarise(count = n())

match2 <- match %>% group_by(key) %>%
                    summarise(match_count = n(),
                              cdr3s = paste(unique(junction_aa), collapse = " "),
                              n_types = n_distinct(type),
                              types = paste(unique(type), collapse = " "))

match3 <- meta_pred_large %>% left_join(match2, by = "key")
match3$n_types[is.na(match3$n_types)] <- 0
match4 <- match3 %>% group_by(donor) %>%
                     mutate(n_clones = n()) %>%
                     group_by(donor, n_types) %>%
                     summarise(pct = 100 * n() / dplyr::first(n_clones),
                               subset_n = n(),
                               num_clones = dplyr::first(n_clones)) %>%
                     ungroup()

match4 <- match4 %>% complete(donor, n_types)
match4$pct[is.na(match4$pct)] <- 0
match4$n_types = factor(match4$n_types)
```

```{r}
meta <- meta %>% rowwise() %>% mutate(existing_chains = sum(a1_pred, a2_pred, b1_pred, b2_pred),
                                      predicted_chains = chain_count - sum(a1_pred, a2_pred, b1_pred, b2_pred))


match <- match %>% unite("key", c(scR_CTaa, CTaa, donor), sep = " ", remove = FALSE)
meta <- meta %>% unite("key", c(scR_CTaa, CTaa, donor), sep = " ", remove = FALSE)

meta_pred <- meta %>% filter(predicted_chains > 0)

meta_pred_large <- meta %>% filter(predicted_chains > 0) %>%
                            group_by(scR_CTaa) %>%
                            filter(n() >= 10) %>%
                            ungroup()

meta_pred_large <- meta %>% filter(predicted_chains > 0) %>%
                            group_by(scR_CTaa) %>%
                            filter(n() >= 10) %>%
                            ungroup() %>%
                            group_by(donor, scR_CTaa, CTaa, key) %>%
                            summarise(count = n())

match2 <- match %>% group_by(key) %>%
                    summarise(match_count = n(),
                              cdr3s = paste(unique(junction_aa), collapse = " "),
                              n_types = n_distinct(type),
                              types = paste(unique(type), collapse = " "))

match3 <- meta_pred_large %>% left_join(match2, by = "key")
match3$n_types[is.na(match3$n_types)] <- 0
match4 <- match3 %>% group_by(donor) %>%
                     mutate(n_clones = n()) %>%
                     group_by(donor, n_types) %>%
                     summarise(pct = 100 * n() / dplyr::first(n_clones),
                               subset_n = n(),
                               num_clones = dplyr::first(n_clones)) %>%
                     ungroup()

match4 <- match4 %>% complete(donor, n_types)
match4$pct[is.na(match4$pct)] <- 0
match4$n_types = factor(match4$n_types)

match4 <- match4 %>% group_by(donor) %>%
                     arrange(desc(num_clones)) %>%
                     mutate(num_clones = case_when(
                                                   is.na(num_clones) ~ dplyr::first(num_clones),
                                                   !is.na(num_clones) ~ num_clones)) %>%
                     ungroup()


match5 <- match4 %>% filter(num_clones >= 5)

match_order <- match5 %>% group_by(donor) %>%
                          summarise(count = pct[n_types == 0]) %>%
                          arrange(count)

match5 %>% ggplot(aes(x = donor, y = pct)) +
           geom_col(aes(fill = n_types)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey90", "skyblue", "dodgerblue", "blue", "navyblue")) +
           theme_bw() +
           theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
                 panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
                 axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
                 axis.title = element_text(size = 16, color = "black")) +
           scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
           labs(x = "Donor", y = "% of clones", fill = "Number of\ntypes of\nvalidation") +
           scale_x_discrete(limits = match_order$donor)


match5 %>% ggplot(aes(x = donor, y = pct)) +
           geom_col(aes(fill = n_types)) +
           scale_fill_manual(values = alpha("olivedrab4", c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1))) +
           theme_bw() +
           theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
                 panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
                 axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
                 axis.title = element_text(size = 16, color = "black")) +
           scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
           labs(x = "Donor", y = "% of clones", fill = "Number of\ntypes of\nvalidation") +
           scale_x_discrete(limits = match_order$donor)

mel <- match5

median(100 - mel$pct[mel$n_types == 0])


mel$cancer <- "Melanoma"
rcc$cancer <- "Renal Cell Carcinoma"
both_lev <- rbind(mel, rcc)
mel_lev <- mel
rcc_lev <- rcc
both_order_lev <- both_lev %>% group_by(donor, cancer) %>%

both_order_lev %>% group_by(cancer) %>%
```
